questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted near schools. It warns drivers to slow down and watch carefully for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and stop if needed to let other vehicles, bicycles, or pedestrians pass first. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light permitted with caution.
All traffic must turn right at next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means right turns are prohibited.

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn to go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted where you are not allowed to enter. You may see it on one-way streets or when entering an expressway ramp the wrong way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Triangular signs pointing downward mean you must yield. Slow down to a safe speed and stop if necessary. If you stop, do so at the marked stop line if one exists.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming construction or maintenance area.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming construction or maintenance area.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about upcoming hazards. Orange warning signs indicate construction areas.

options.text: Turning on a red signal is prohibited.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turning on a red signal is prohibited.
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells drivers that turning right or left on a red signal is not allowed.

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right of the median.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a reverse curve. The road curves to the right first, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to hazards immediately ahead. This sign tells you that traffic is merging onto the road from your right. Be prepared to allow them to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has multiple curves.

questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about available services like rest areas, food, gas, and hospitals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that the divided highway is ending ahead. Prepare to shift your lane position as oncoming traffic may be present.

options.text: Are traveling in the wrong direction.
Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
May not proceed until it changes to green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. Come to a complete stop at the stop line or before the crosswalk. Yield to all other traffic and pedestrians.

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guards signals for you to go.
Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that you are leaving a divided roadway and entering a two-way highway where traffic travels in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you what is coming ahead. The speed number on the sign shows the safe speed to take the upcoming turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May turn left only on a green arrow.
May turn left on a green light when it is safe.
Must wait for the solid green light before you turn left.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn left on a green light when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A sign with "yield" means slow down and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicycles, and pedestrians pass first. Then you can proceed with the rest of the sign's instructions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Come to a complete stop as quickly as possible.
Stop and proceed only when the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and be careful. You do not need to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the road will make a sharp right turn and then a sharp left turn ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be ready to yield or stop before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that one lane is ending ahead and you need to move to the left lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The vehicle is being drawn by an animal.
The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: This emblem warns other drivers that the vehicle moves slowly—25 mph or less. You may see it on bicycles, horse-drawn vehicles, and farm equipment.
